title: Why Billions Of People In Hot Places Have No AC
hook: 2.8 billion people live where it's dangerously hot. Most can't cool down.
closing: The hottest places on Earth can least afford to cool off.
question: Could you survive a heatwave without AC?

segments.say: In the hottest parts of the world, only about 9 percent of homes have an air conditioner.
Global AC demand is projected to more than triple by 2050, reaching 5.6 billion units.
The electricity bill for staying cool is projected to triple by 2050.
